Regionalization by a representative station (C1)

Source: R/regionalize-methods.R
ef_method_station.Rd

Describes configuration C1 for ef_regionalize() and ef_regionalize_cv() (dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 5.3): the surface is constant and equal to the value of the station station_id at each target time, $$v(x) = v_s,$$ or, for air_temperature only and with an explicit lapse rate \(\Gamma\) (variant "station_lapse"), $$v(x) = v_s + \Gamma\,(z(x) - z_s),$$ with z the elevation layer of the covariates (also at the station, decision GW-10).

Usage

ef_method_station(station_id, lapse_rate = NULL)

Arguments

station_id

The identifier of the representative station; no automatic choice (dev/VALIDATION_PLAN.md section 2.2).

lapse_rate

NULL or the vertical gradient [unit of the variable per m, e.g. degC m-1]. No default value exists (TODO in dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 5.3): its value and source are the user's responsibility and are recorded in the provenance.

Value

A list of class "earthflux_regionalization_method" with method = "station" or "station_lapse".

Details

The station-level diagnostic equivalent to cross-validation is the error at the other stations; the representative station itself is not evaluated. Surfaces carry the object flag EF_GWR_SINGLE_STATION. Errors: earthflux_missing_input (station_id), earthflux_input_error (not a single identifier), earthflux_domain_error (infinite lapse rate).

Verification status

The constant surface is a definition of the comparison configuration (no formula to verify). The lapse-rate variant is CANDIDATA: its value has no verified default (radiation-components.md RC-12, option a).

See also

Other spatial regionalization functions: ef_gwr_bandwidth(), ef_gwr_diagnostics(), ef_gwr_fit(), ef_gwr_predict(), ef_gwr_search(), ef_method_gwr(), ef_method_idw(), ef_method_ols(), ef_predict_control(), ef_regionalize(), ef_regionalize_cv(), ef_spatial_folds()

Examples

ef_method_station("ST07")
#> <earthflux_regionalization_method> station 
#> representative station ST07
ef_method_station("ST07", lapse_rate = -0.0065)
#> <earthflux_regionalization_method> station_lapse 
#> representative station ST07, lapse rate -0.0065
